lines: Sound, motion and display: how Telo Ride sounds and moves for an hour in the saddle.
Ride sound is made in the browser from your pedalling: chain, freewheel, tyres and wind. Turn it off, and no audio starts at all.
World music plays each world's own track underneath. Under a class video, ride sound goes quiet until the video pauses.
Reduce motion follows the device, or your choice. On, every transition is instant, and the world stops swaying in the wind.
Large ride numbers make power, the clock and the target a quarter bigger on every ride screen, with nothing scrolling sideways.
Sound and display, from a phone to the full screen.
The theme matches the device, or stays as you pick it. And with full screen on, the start press goes full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
